consigna: One sustained spoken production of at least twelve minutes: brief a listener on a situation you have judged — what you predict, how confident you are, and what you'd tell the person responsible. Include one deliberate drop out of your default register. With a person or recorded alone. Notes are preparation; the delivery is spoken.
requisitos: A prediction as a scenario tree, with the signal that distinguishes the paths (week 9)
No more than two hedges in the whole piece, both deliberate (week 8)
Feedback offered as a hypothesis the other person can correct (week 2)
Register controlled on at least four axes, with one deliberate drop (weeks 5 and 7)
Two passages of bare juxtaposition where a marker would be expected (week 3)
One moment of drawing in a silent listener or handing over the floor (week 4)
microtareas: *Mon (10 min).* Reread the corrections from weeks 2 to 9 and note the one that recurs.
*Wed (5 min).* Write three sentences carrying a graded prediction, a single hedge and a register drop together.
*Fri (10 min).* Record the twelve minutes. Then listen to one minute from the middle: does the control hold there too?
autochequeo: Are all six skills present, or did one crowd out the others?
Did two hedges do the work three would have blurred?
Was the register drop audibly deliberate?
Did the unlinked passages read as confident or as careless?
promptCorreccion: This is a review of six skills at once: scenario-tree prediction, sparing hedging, feedback as hypothesis, multi-axis register control, deliberate non-linking and conversational stewardship. (1) For each, say whether it is present and whether it is done well. (2) Say which collapsed. (3) Give me one sentence carrying three of them. Correct nothing outside these six areas. ---
